sentences.en: Susie can type many times as fast as I can.
sentences.zh: 苏茜打字的速度是我的好几倍。

sentences.en: All sweaters of this type are out of stock now.
sentences.zh: 这种毛衣现在都断货了。

sentences.en: My boss dictated a letter for his secretary to type.
sentences.zh: 老板口述了一封信让秘书来打字。
